import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {

    static final int MAXN = 1000005;
    static int n, k, p;
    static int[] fac = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] ifac = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] f;
    static int[][] fa = new int[19][1 << 19];
    static int[][] fc = new int[19][1 << 19];

    static void solve() throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        p = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int nn = n;
        int maxBit = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            if ((n & i) == i) {
                int t = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                    if (((n >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                        t <<= 1;
                        t |= ((i >> j) & 1);
                    }
                }
                if (f == null) {
                    f = new int[1 << 20];
                }
                if (f.length < t + 1) {
                    f = Arrays.copyOf(f, t + 1);
                }
                f[t] = i;
                nn = Math.max(nn, t);
            }
        }

        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(fpow(k, n, p));
            return;
        }

        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) {
            fac[i] = mult(fac[i - 1], i, p);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            ifac[i] = inv(fac[i], p);
        }

        int size = nn + 1;
        int[] a = new int[size];
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            int fi = (i < f.length) ? f[i] : 0;
            a[i] = ifac[fi];
        }

        int res = fpow(k, n, p);
        a = subsetPowConvol(a, k, p);
        int combinatorial = mult(a[nn], fac[n], p);
        submod(res, combinatorial, p);
        System.out.println(res);
    }

    static int transform(int[] a, int n, int p, boolean invert) {
        int k = 31 - Integer.numberOfLeadingZeros(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            for (int msk = 0; msk < n; msk++) {
                if (((msk >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                    int pmsk = msk ^ (1 << i);
                    if (!invert) {
                        addmod(a, msk, a[pmsk], p);
                    } else {
                        submod(a, msk, a[pmsk], p);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int[] powConvol(int[] a, int k, int p) {
        int n = a.length;
        if (k == 1) {
            return a;
        } else if ((k & 1) == 1) {
            int[] r = powConvol(a, k - 1, p);
            int[] res = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= n - i - 1; j++) {
                    res[i + j] = (int) ((res[i + j] + (long) r[i] * a[j]) % p);
                }
            }
            return res;
        } else {
            int[] r = powConvol(a, k >> 1, p);
            int[] res = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= n - i - 1; j++) {
                    res[i + j] = (int) ((res[i + j] + (long) r[i] * r[j]) % p);
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static int[] subsetPowConvol(int[] a, int k, int p) {
        final int logn = 19;
        int n = a.length;
        int len = 1;
        while (len < n) len <<= 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < logn; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(fa[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(fc[i], 0);
            for (int j = 0; j < len; j++) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(j) == i && j < a.length) {
                    fa[i][j] = a[j];
                } else {
                    fa[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
            transform(fa[i], len, p, false);
        }
        int[] res = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int[] va = new int[logn];
            for (int j = 0; j < logn; j++) {
                va[j] = fa[j][i];
            }
            va = powConvol(va, k, p);
            for (int j = 0; j < logn; j++) {
                fc[j][i] = va[j];
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < logn; i++) {
            transform(fc[i], len, p, true);
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(j) == i && j < fc[i].length) {
                    res[j] = fc[i][j];
                }
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static long gcd(long a, long b) {
        while (b != 0) {
            long r = a % b;
            a = b;
            b = r;
        }
        return a;
    }

    static long lcm(long a, long b) {
        return a / gcd(a, b) * b;
    }

    static long fpow(long n, int k, int p) {
        long r = 1;
        long base = n % p;
        while (k > 0) {
            if ((k & 1) == 1) {
                r = (r * base) % p;
            }
            base = (base * base) % p;
            k >>= 1;
        }
        return r;
    }

    static int inv(int a, int p) {
        return (int) fpow(a, p - 2, p);
    }

    static void addmod(int[] a, int msk, int val, int p) {
        a[msk] = (a[msk] + val) % p;
    }

    static void submod(int[] a, int msk, int val, int p) {
        a[msk] = (a[msk] - val) % p;
        if (a[msk] < 0) a[msk] += p;
    }

    static int mult(int a, int b, int p) {
        return (int) ((long) a * b % p);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        solve();
    }
}
